basic_details.job_title: CNP Nashik Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Currency Note Press Nashik (CNP Nashik) has notified 2 vacancies for the post of Consultant (Civil) on a contract basis. Eligible candidates must send their offline applications by post to The Chief General Manager, Currency Note Press, Nashik Road, Nashik (Maharashtra) on or before 30 October 2026. Applicants must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (BE/B.Tech). The notified pay for the post is Rs. 5,000 per day all inclusive, and the selection process involves shortlisting based on experience profile followed by an interview.

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: The applicant must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (BE/B.Tech) from a recognized university or institution in India. Postgraduate qualification (M.E/M.Tech) in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management, or Infrastructure Engineering is considered desirable. | Professional Experience: Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in civil engineering works in India, preferably in Central Government Departments, State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous bodies, or Government-funded institutions/authorities. | Relevant Technical Experience: Demonstrated experience in project planning and design, preparation and review of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), preparation of cost estimates, BOQ, and technical specifications, supervision and monitoring of construction activities, and conducting site inspections and technical evaluations. | Senior Level Position Experience: Must have held senior engineering or managerial positions during their service career or undertaken works/rendered consultancy of the nature mentioned for at least 5 projects of value Rs. 10 Crore and above, preferably for government departments/PSUs (such as Superintending Engineer, Executive Engineer, General Manager (Civil) in PSU, Additional General Manager (Civil) in PSU). | Age Limit: The consultant should not be more than 64 years of age as on the last date of application i.e. 30-10-2026. Must be medically fit and capable of undertaking field visits and technical inspections. | Other Conditions: Must have retired from government service or PSU with a clean and satisfactory service record. No vigilance, disciplinary, or criminal case or investigation should be pending. The individual or their firm must not be blacklisted by any government department/entity.

selection_process: Candidates will be shortlisted keeping in view their experience profile etc. called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: CNP Nashik Consultant (Civil) at a Glance

rows.details: Currency Note Press, Nashik (CNP Nashik) / SPMCIL
Consultant (Civil) for the Civil Works Panel on Day-to-Day basis

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Duly completed applications must be sent by post to the Chief General Manager, Currency Note Press, Nashik Road, Nashik (Maharashtra) - 422101. The outer cover should be subscribed as "APPLICATION FOR EMPANELMENT AS CONSULTANT (CIVIL) for Civil Works Panel on DAY-TO-DAY need Basis".

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: The applicant must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (BE/B.Tech) from a recognized university or institution in India. Postgraduate qualification (M.E/M.Tech) in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management, or Infrastructure Engineering is considered desirable. Professional Experience: Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in civil engineering works in India, preferably in Central Government Departments, State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous bodies, or Government-funded institutions/authorities. Relevant Technical Experience: Demonstrated experience in project planning and design, preparation and review of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), preparation of cost estimates, BOQ, and technical specifications, supervision and monitoring of construction activities, and conducting site inspections and technical evaluations. Senior Level Position Experience: Must have held senior engineering or managerial positions during their service career or undertaken works/rendered consultancy of the nature mentioned for at least 5 projects of value Rs. 10 Crore and above, preferably for government departments/PSUs (such as Superintending Engineer, Executive Engineer, General Manager (Civil) in PSU, Additional General Manager (Civil) in PSU). Age Limit: The consultant should not be more than 64 years of age as on the last date of application i.e. 30-10-2026. Must be medically fit and capable of undertaking field visits and technical inspections. Other Conditions: Must have retired from government service or PSU with a clean and satisfactory service record. No vigilance, disciplinary, or criminal case or investigation should be pending. The individual or their firm must not be blacklisted by any government department/entity.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates in support of educational qualification, age, and experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted keeping in view their experience profile etc. called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The empanelment will be purely on a need basis initially for a period of one year, which may be extended by another year subject to performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this consultant position?
faq.answer: Retired government servants, PSU employees, serving/retired faculty in Govt. institutions (domain experts), or private qualified consultants fulfilling the educational and 20 years of professional experience criteria may apply.

faq.question: Q3. Are there any age relaxations specified for the post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any age relaxations, stating only that the consultant should not be more than 64 years of age as on 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the empanelment?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted keeping in view their experience profile and subsequently called for an interview.
